entities.summary: Illya Chychkan is a Ukrainian artist. He is a representative of the art Ukrainian New Wave movement, which emerged in the 1990s. He is a third generation artist. He lives and works in Berlin, and Kyiv, as a painter, author of installations, and develops photo and video-projects.
